album.title: Radif of Persian Music on Setar I

just_intervals.note: measured octave minus 1200 ¢, register to register

progression.narrative: The performance opens on E4 and dwells most on D in Feyli. The line peaks at G4 (395.6 Hz) at 0:13.9. It closes on D3, not the tonic (D4 → D4 → D4 → D3 → E4 → D3).

theory_fit.name: Pythagorean / Safi al-Din

theory_fit.name: Farhat interval classes
theory_fit.description: Interval classes Hormoz Farhat measured in performance practice ("The Dastgah Concept in Persian Music", 1990). Approximate centres.

flags: tonic G set in the catalog (Bayat-e Tork's finalis G (198.7 Hz): seven of the suite's fourteen tracks voted it and the pitch set fits from it (0, 205, 405, 488, 702, 905, 1052 cents). The vote picked the 3rd below (the 6th). Inference, not yet by ear); the runs' vote favoured 167.4 Hz (E)
